name: Dungeon Lootify [BETA]
desc:
🔥 Grab your sword, rally your crew, and dive into dungeons teeming with treasure and terror! 🔥

[How To Play]
• 🤝 Team Up – Gather allies around the table to start your party
• 🏹 Risk It All – Battle monsters and colossal bosses... but BEWARE: Death means losing everything!
• 💎 Get Rich or Die Trying – Loot chests for legendary gear... then decide: push deeper for greater rewards, or flee to safety!

Pro Tip: The deeper you go, the deadlier the traps — and the juicier the prizes! Fortune favors the bold… but only the living keep their gold.

This game is still in Alpha and will be updated every week. If you meet any problems, please post on our group wall or in our dc server!
